editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The lesson starts with a professional question, audience and desired short briefing, then follows research choice, drafting, source/claim checks and the resulting Word document. It teaches the ordinary complete journey rather than a legal edge case.
editorial.inputs_and_request: The localized fictional Imprese Arco request supplies scope, intended readers and a two-page limit. The attached original Spanish official directive and explanatory guide are starting sources, not a prewritten answer. Language is not treated as jurisdiction.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The current planning and validation helpers process the bound source files and the model-authored answer. Checkpoints ask the learner to explain the question and find a conclusion, its source and a remaining limitation. Codex retains teacher and working chats; the packaged Cowork lesson uses written instruction in one conversation.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Actual Word documents are readable and stay within two pages in every language. Citations identify the original EU text and a dated official legislative-status check. The claim audit retains national-law/current-version limitations and professional review remains pending. These general briefings do not decide an individual debt.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The changed request adds public-authority suppliers. A new planning and answer run in the same engagement adds the distinct public-debtor rules and preserves every earlier run file. Repeat instructions ask for facts, jurisdiction, audience and output before research.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Italian instructions consistently describe the complete first-use journey and source review. The six outline sections total 390 seconds; research, processing, questions and user review can extend the session. No human timing is claimed.

The two-page render is legible without clipping or missing glyphs; professional decisions remain pending.
